specification.study_status: Exploratory protocol fixed after prior scalar results were known, before new signed-vector/outcome associations. Not external preregistration.
specification.numerical_QC_gate: Require all193 x two orientations complete with passing exact selected-layer prefix checks and per-coordinate/reference-direction repeats. Never silently exclude numerical failures or replace prefix values.
specification.cell_dependence: Supporting cell shares variants and is not an independent variant replication cohort.
specification.outcome: Published paired replicate mean WT full-length minus ALT full-length percentage points, retain negative outcomes, no clipping of predictions.
specification.primary_effect: MDA_MB_231 macro-exon MAE(scalar_plus_signed) minus macro-exon MAE(scalar_matched7), norm assayed_exon.
specification.matched_scalar7: common5 plus forward and RC Euclidean norms of the pooled signed delta of THIS layer/region. Thus every pair has its own matched baseline.
specification.secondary_pairs: Six fixed layers at assay exon plus five fixed regions at norm, ten unique pairs including primary. Report every pair; no overall best-layer claim from differing baselines.
specification.baseline_kernel: Featurewise training mean/std (ddof0), drop exact training constants; divide concatenated features by sqrt(number_active_columns).
specification.vector_kernel: Each orientation separately: center features by training mean, divide by sqrt(training mean squared Euclidean norm). Average the two active orientation Gram matrices.
specification.unit_direction: Normalize each raw per-variant per-orientation delta by its own Euclidean norm before training center/RMS scaling. Exactzero vectors remain zero.
specification.combined_kernel: Equal average of active scalar and vector kernels. If a block has no training variation it is inactive and remaining weights renormalize. Exact duplicate scalar kernel is identical to scalar kernel.
specification.raw_Gram: Raw label-free dot products may be precomputed, but centering and scales use training indices only. No full-cohort standardization, PCA or phenotype-based selection.
specification.solver: y intercept=train mean; c=(K + n_train*lambda*I)^(-1)(y-trainmean); prediction=Ktesttrain*c+trainmean. Uniform variant weights in fitting.
specification.lambda_selection: Inner leave-one-assay-exon-out mean of exon MAEs. Ties within1e-12 choose largest lambda. Transforms recalculated in every inner split.
specification.outer_split: Leave one of12 assay exons out. Every ALT at the same genomic position stays in one exon. Overlapping32k contexts and single gene limit independence.
specification.metrics: Primary macro-exon MAE; variant-weighted MAE, RMSE and Spearman are supporting. Larger exon (66variants) has more training weight, but same weight as other exons in primary evaluation.

bootstrap.interpretation: Percentile95% intervals conditional on fixed outer OOF predictions and12exons. Do not include retraining/tuning uncertainty. No multiplicity-adjusted discovery claims.

specification.interpretation_limit: Information beyond specified linear scalar baseline, not beyond all nonlinear score relationships or anatomy. REF control does not remove all context confounding. Association is not mechanism or clinical pathogenicity.
specification.no_paid_API_or_new_model_training: Only small statistical ridge probes are fitted to frozen Evo2 outputs; checkpoint unchanged.
